reports.desc: I was put on an automatic renewal subscription I did not want.

Fast Exit specialists offered $100 for us to attend a presentation on exiting from timeshares.  We attended and they gave us some lame excuse that we attended another timeshare presentation owned by one of their other companies they owned.  They did not tell us in advance that we consequently did not qualify because of that.  We sat through the presentation and felt that we were scammed or frauded because they did not fulfill their obligation. We know this industry is filled with fraud and scamming, but we felt abused and used.  We feel others should know about this business' scandalous ways.

I ordered 2 dresses, I got 1 low quality, it' didn't fit, when I tried to get refund, they started sending email asking for a lot of information even signed a paper to return it. Then when it was done, they said it will be a lot of problems for the customer to return it it's better for the customer to keep the dress and they will give me the 50% back and then they don't want to give the 50% back in my CC ,they want to put this money as a credit store<br class="t-last-br" />
Had bought coins then a membership but never got any member benefits and still had to keep buying coins …. A couple on site improved to them they were fake

Scammer sent message to my 80 year old mother via text on her phone saying she was hacked and needed to contact them. They offered her a phone number to call and she called +1 (877) 489-2671 and talked to someone there but felt overwhelmed and ended the call. She is somewhat senile so she says she didn't give them anything important but there is a good chance she did. They called back later 3x via FaceTime audio from applesecurehelpdesk1@gmail.com but she never answered.

Told me I had a charge I didn’t so at all in Orlando Florida I don’t live there tried to get me to open my apple application did not
They ask for my email address my phone number and front and back pictures of my drivers license and a picture of me holding my drivers license.
Legit looking website. Charged me. Typical responses and updates until the delivery attempts started getting suspicious. Given none of them matched a single residential house on my block.

Kroll settlement hid their notice in my spam email which was found after the deadline, then they did not notify me of a second settlement I qualified for and only just saw two days after the deadline.
They also owe me $315 from. CPAP settlement they they are making no effort to pay. They sent me a check and then cancelled it when I deposited it in my bank. Then they sent me codes for two virtual credit cards- one for $260 and one for $55. Neither worked. When i contacted them they said they sent out bad cards and that the virtual credit card company had to contact them to get new cards issued. WHY?!?! If they knew they sent out bad cards for money they owed me, and other people then why are they sitting on it?!?!
They also owe me now for two settlements agains Lemonaid pharmacy for not disclosing that I qualified for payouts until AFTER the deadline to submit. They are stealing money that has rightly been won in the courts.

I ordered bourbon from an online liquor store called Garden Liquors. It appeared to be an actual liquor store that could ship out of state. Everything seemed OK. The item never was delivered even though they sent tracking notices through USPS that seemed very legitimate. The website is now down, the email is now down,

Saw an ad for a discount site selling watches, went to the site, and ordered a watch. It took over two weeks to arrive, and was packaged weirdly- incorrect watch box, wrapped in cellophane. I requested a return via email, in accordance with their website’s instructions. They only respond once daily at 2am, with what appears to be an AI chatbot. It’s been a month of back & forth and now they’re not responding, after saying returns aren’t permitted for a “change of mind,” although that’s part of their policy on their website.
This business is shady, difficult to communicate with, and outright lies about returning items on their website.
